svg.title: White Panel II
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. A curved upper edge is retained; approximate photo-based contour. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://high.org/collection/white-panel-ii/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
